description: Two to five companies as suppliers, the same facts for each: what they sell (by evidence tier: official = contracts, observed = postings and stacks, claimed = their own words), contracts won and how (bidders, direct award, buyers that came back), framework places, typical contract size against the market of their category, where they deliver from, sanctions.
